DF-CLI-DISPATCH.Summary: M-CLI-ENTRY dispatches-subcommand to each grace subcommand CLI (lint, module, file, status, afk, evolve).

DF-LINT-PIPELINE.Summary: M-CLI-LINT invokes M-LINT-CORE, which uses the language adapters, the lint config, and the skill-section checks.

DF-QUERY-PIPELINE.Summary: M-CLI-MODULE and M-CLI-FILE use M-QUERY-CORE for artifact queries; M-QUERY-RENDER formats-types-from M-QUERY-CORE; M-QUERY-CORE reads-ignored-dirs from M-LINT-CONFIG.

DF-STATUS-PIPELINE.Summary: M-CLI-STATUS delegates-to M-STATUS-RUNTIME, which uses M-QUERY-CORE for artifact counts.

DF-AFK-SESSION-FLOW.Summary: M-CLI-AFK uses the afk session store, journal writers, config resolution, Telegram transport, and the usage-cache reader.

DF-EVOLVE-PIPELINE.Summary: M-CLI-EVOLVE invokes M-EVOLVE-ORCHESTRATOR and uses M-EVOLVE-SPEC and M-EVOLVE-ARCHIVE; the orchestrator uses runner, worktree, score, and archive; the runner uses the metric parser.

DF-SKILLS-MIRROR.Summary: M-SKILLS-PACKAGED is a mirror-of M-SKILLS-CANONICAL; M-MARKETPLACE-MANIFEST declares-skills from the packaged mirror.

DF-MARKETPLACE-VALIDATION.Summary: M-VALIDATE-MARKETPLACE validates the marketplace manifest and validates-sync-with both the canonical and the packaged skill trees.
